order.wallet.help.title: You need a browser wallet to tap Pay
order.wallet.help.lead: This page talks to MetaMask or Coinbase Wallet in your browser. Safari usually has no wallet built in.
order.wallet.help.desktop.title: On a computer
order.wallet.help.desktop.body: Install the MetaMask or Coinbase Wallet extension in Chrome, Brave, or Edge. Unlock the wallet, then refresh this page. Safari often cannot inject a wallet — use Chrome, Brave, or Edge, or send USDC yourself and paste the transaction hash below.
order.wallet.help.mobile.title: On a phone
order.wallet.help.mobile.body: Open MetaMask or Coinbase Wallet, use the in-app browser, and go to this site. Safari or Chrome alone on a phone usually have no wallet.
order.wallet.help.fallback: Already sent the USDC? Expand “Paste the transaction hash” below and enter the 0x… hash from your wallet.
how.title: How it works
how.lede: Buy a track or album with USDC. We verify the payment on-chain, then send download links.
how.1: Browse the shop and add a track or the full album.
how.2: Enter your email (for delivery) and pay in USDC on Base with a wallet, or paste a transaction hash.
how.3: Archonia Verify verifies the transfer. You get download links on the order page and by email.
how.downloads: Each file link works up to 5 times and expires after 7 days — enough for retries. Save the files locally.
how.ax402: Payments are verified by Archonia Verify — the buyer payment goes 100% to the merchant wallet.
